name: LLM Council
description: LLM Council after Karpathy and Ole Lehmann: five thinking-lens advisors (Contrarian, First Principles, Expansionist, Outsider, Executor), cast from your own models, answer, review each other anonymously, and a chairman delivers the verdict.
author: eskwisit
safetyNotes: Declarative skill only. agent.prompt.inject is used solely to index the LLM Council skill for the agent's Skill tool; main.js does nothing at runtime. The bundled scripts/council.py is run by the agent through its normal shell tool. It copies the seven council sub-agent definitions (subagents/*.md) to ~/.agents/subagents, the only place PI-Desktop loads sub-agents from. It keeps the user's model exclusions and last confirmed cast in ~/.llm-council/config.json and cast.json. During a run it keeps the model catalog, the cast, the failover log, the secret label map and the anonymized answers in ~/.llm-council/private/ so reviewers cannot read them. Reports are written to the workspace run directory. No model is hard-coded: the agent casts seats from the user's own delegation model list. It makes no network calls.
